messages:
Maya S.: Heads-up: invoice-preview for a few large tenants shows repeated token flips after we enabled route-fallback v2 this morning :grimacing:
Ethan R.: flip how? preview <> ledger delta or attribution flips in the finalizer?
Maya S.: preview snapshots spike then settle. final ledger reconciles down. sample trace: req=0x9a7b route=primary->fallback->primary finalizer flips attribution twice
Priya K.: that smells like double-emit from the edge when fallback triggers then primary retries. Are we deduping by req_id at the preview aggregator?
Maya S.: preview currently uses first-seen per req_id per window. duplicate req_ids across different route ids are slipping through when route tag differs
Ethan R.: bug: preview key is (req_id, route_id) not just req_id. we intended to dedupe globally. changing that could impact throughput though
Priya K.: options: 1) dedupe by global req_id (strong correctness, perf hit) 2) keep per-route but set preview confidence flag when same req seen multiple routes 3) add side-channel anomaly counter and soft-lock preview for 30s on any req with multi-route sightings
metering-bot: alert MTR-FALLBACK-FLIP created for tenants [big-tenant-1] (rule: >10 flips / 10m)
Ethan R.: prefer option 3 as low-risk. soft-lock + anomaly counter gives ops visibility and keeps perf.
ConsoleBot: note: product requests "preview_confidence" icon and tooltip for billing previews if implemented
Priya K.: agreed. we'll implement soft-lock at aggregator layer (30s TTL), emit metric preview.reassign_attempts, and add preview_confidence tag [high|low|tentative]
Maya S.: I'll open a small PR to change the keying and add the TTL as a feature-flag. Canaries on shadow plane only. ETA today afternoon.
Ethan R.: add unit test: replay same req over two routes out-of-order and assert preview shows only one attribution when TTL applied
Priya K.: QA will run 24h canary comparing preview_vs_ledger totals and flag >3% deltas. tagging billing-ops on alert channel.
Maya S.: PR: https://git.redwood/infer/streaming/pulls/3099 — will add telemetry + feature flag description. deploying to shadow canary at 2025-08-05T15:00Z
metering-bot: canary scheduled: streaming-preview-ttl-v1 -> shadow (tenants: big-tenant-1) at 2025-08-05T15:00Z
